Udacity Data Analyst project using a TMDB movie dataset.

Exploring the economics of movies

Investigate how revenue, budget, genre, runtime and release year vary across films.

Python · pandas · Matplotlib · Seaborn

The question

A broad movie dataset contains several plausible stories, but missing and skewed values need care.

The work

  • Inspect numerical distributions and clean the movie data.
  • Compare budgets and revenues across genres.
  • Explore runtime, release-year and cast/director patterns.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Original figures show genre-level budget/revenue comparisons and movie revenue rankings.

What I learned

  • Build a coherent analytical narrative while keeping observational associations separate from causal claims.

Project context

  • Historical movie dataset; missing and zero budget/revenue entries affect interpretation.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
